args.details: Container task for repository and delivery foundation. Execution is split into three child tasks: monorepo structure, environment configuration, and CI/CD pipeline. Track completion via the children.

initial_arguments.name: Set up repository, environments, and CI/CD skeleton
initial_arguments.details: Create the monorepo structure (pipelines, dashboard app, shared libs), dev/staging/prod environment configs, linting, test harness, and a basic CI/CD pipeline that builds and deploys a hello-world artifact.

args.details: Container task for the operations/log analytics page. Execution is split into three child tasks: KPI header, error signature and anomaly panel, and page layout/filter wiring. Track completion via the children.

initial_arguments.name: Assemble operations and log analytics dashboard page
initial_arguments.details: Compose the operations view: traffic volume, error rate, latency percentiles, top error signatures, and anomaly callouts, wired to the log marts and global filters.

initial_arguments.name: Milestone 1 — Data Foundation & Architecture
initial_arguments.details: Establish the technical foundation for the dashboard: define data sources and schemas, choose the storage/query layer, and set up the project skeleton and environments. This milestone unblocks all three data domains (CSV, logs, visualization).

initial_arguments.name: Milestone 2 — Customer CSV Data Processing
initial_arguments.details: Build the end-to-end pipeline that ingests customer CSV files, validates and cleans the data, transforms it into analytics-ready models, and loads it into the warehouse. Includes handling malformed rows, deduplication, and incremental loads.

initial_arguments.name: Milestone 3 — Application Log Analysis
initial_arguments.details: Build the log ingestion and analysis pipeline: parse application logs, normalize fields, compute operational metrics (error rates, latency, traffic), and expose aggregated log insights for the dashboard.

initial_arguments.name: Milestone 4 — Visualization Components
initial_arguments.details: Design and build the reusable visualization layer: chart components, KPI tiles, filters, and dashboard layouts that consume the customer and log data models. Includes accessibility, responsiveness, and performance considerations.

initial_arguments.name: Milestone 5 — Integration, QA & Launch
initial_arguments.details: Integrate pipelines and visualizations into a single dashboard, run end-to-end testing, performance tuning, security review, and deploy to production with monitoring and documentation.
